ideas.idea: Give each page its own title and description via useHead/useSeoMeta
ideas.why: Only app.vue sets a title, so pages share identical metadata; per-page values are concrete and repo-specific.

ideas.idea: Remove the /guides noindex middleware rule because the sitemap lists the page
ideas.why: The middleware header contradicts the sitemap entry and the guides page is public content.

ideas.idea: Flesh out guides page with actual routes (grade, distance, area), each on its own /guides/<route> page
ideas.why: guides.vue has only a heading and a one-line sentence with no routes, so real content would give crawlers and readers something to understand.

ideas.idea: Add intro text and links to guides on the home page
ideas.why: index.vue has only an h1 and a button, so text and real links add content and a crawlable path.

ideas.idea: Add a canonical link on each page
ideas.why: No canonical exists anywhere in the code; a concrete fix once the domain is known.

ideas.idea: Add WebSite and Organization JSON-LD structured data
ideas.why: No JSON-LD exists, but this advice would fit almost any site and has little effect on a small site.

ideas.idea: Add <lastmod> dates to the sitemap and/or use a Nuxt sitemap module to generate it
ideas.why: Accurate, as the sitemap has no dates, but it has small effect for a two-URL sitemap.

ideas.idea: Replace the placeholder trailhead.example domain with the real domain in the sitemap and robots.txt
ideas.why: The sitemap uses a .example placeholder domain, so real URLs are needed for it to work.

ideas.idea: Set a site URL in the Nuxt config
ideas.why: nuxt.config.ts has no site URL, which canonical and sitemap generation need.
